current.text: Christian Anderson is a rookie. Charlotte took him 18th overall in the 2026 draft.
He will not start. Coby White is Charlotte's starting guard.
The team does not yet trust him as the backup point guard. Walker calls him a fun archetype rather than a functional one for now.
Coby White has a calf injury and will probably miss the start of the season.
His Summer League was disappointing because he shot poorly. His high three-point volume there was a good sign.
One dynasty rookie ranking puts him 16th in the class. The speaker really likes him.

durable.text: Experts see two outlier skills, passing and shooting. He could be the best passer and possibly the best shooter in the 2026 class.
He takes a high volume of threes.
He is undersized. Experts list his size and his defense as the main concerns.
